message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta’s local authorities.  
In the United States “local council” is usually referred to as the **City Council** or the **City Government**, and noise complaints are handled by the city’s police department or code‑enforcement office.

### How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta

| Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Contact |
|------|------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | **Identify the source** – Is it a residential building, a commercial venue, a construction site, etc.? Knowing this helps the police or code‑enforcement team respond appropriately. | — |
| 2 | **File online** – Use the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal. You can submit a noise complaint form, attach photos or audio recordings, and specify the time and location. | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |
| 3 | **Call the 311 hotline** – If you prefer speaking to someone or if you’re unable to use the online portal. | 404‑656‑4000 (Atlanta Police Department) |
| 4 | **Visit the police station** – For urgent or ongoing disturbances, you can go to the nearest Atlanta Police Department precinct. | — |
| 5 | **Follow up** – After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. Keep it handy if you need to check on the status or provide additional information. | — |

### Key Points

- **Noise Ordinance**: Atlanta’s noise ordinance (Title 10, Chapter 1 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) sets limits on permissible sound levels and defines “noisy” activities. Violations can result in citations or fines.
- **Time Restrictions**: Generally, noise is regulated more strictly between 10 p.m. and 7 a.m. on weekdays and 11 p.m. to 7 a.m. on weekends.
- **Documentation**: If possible, record the noise (audio or video) and note the date, time, and location. This evidence can help the police or code‑enforcement officers assess the situation.
- **Repeat Offenders**: Persistent violators may face escalating penalties, including fines, community service, or even civil injunctions.

### Quick Contact Details

| Agency | Phone | Website |
|--------|-------|---------|
| Atlanta Police Department (311) | 404‑656‑4000 | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |
| City of Atlanta Code Enforcement | 404‑656‑4000 | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |
| City of Atlanta 311 Service | 404‑656‑4000 | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |

---

**Bottom line:** Yes, you can report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta. Use the 311 online portal or call 404‑656‑4000 to file a complaint, and the city’s police or code‑enforcement team will investigate.
